name: clip-anything
description: Marketplace for Clip Anything: a Claude Code skill that turns a long gameplay recording into vertical highlight clips with the local clip-anything CLI.

plugins.name: clip-anything
plugins.description: Make highlight clips, shorts and reels from a gameplay recording or a folder of recordings. Runs the free, local clip-anything CLI (uvx), shows the picks before rendering, explains each pick from report.json. Nothing is uploaded.
